name: Equinox Gender Diverse Health Centre
title: Clinic
description: Equinox is Thorne Harbour Health's clinic specialising in trans and gender diverse health - a general practice for trans and gender diverse people. "Start, continue or manage gender-affirming hormone therapy with an Equinox GP using the Informed Consent Model." Also offers sexual health care (HIV/STI testing, PrEP) through a trans and gender diverse health lens, and referrals for gender-affirming surgery.
specialties: Trans and gender diverse general practice, gender-affirming hormone therapy, sexual health, PrEP, surgery referrals

name: Equinox Endocrinology (Specialist Hormone Initiation)
title: Endocrinology service
description: "Our endocrinology service supports adults aged 18+ to initiate hormone therapy before transferring ongoing hormone care back to their regular GP." Requires a GP referral; appointments on Fridays in person at Equinox or by telehealth anywhere in Victoria; usually up to five appointments and bulk-billed for Medicare card holders. Separate from the Equinox GP clinic.

name: Northside Clinic
title: Clinic
description: "At Northside Clinic we are experienced in supporting the health and wellbeing of the trans, gender diverse and non binary people." Most GPs prescribe hormones after a mental health assessment by a gender-specialist psychiatrist or clinical psychologist; "Some Northside Clinic GPs start hormones for gender affirmation using the 'informed consent' model". Practice nurses provide hormone education incl. testosterone self-injection. Under-18s are usually seen at the RCH Gender Clinic. Private billing practice (bulk billing only for some pensioner/HCC groups). Site lists 18 GPs (Richard Moore, Ruth McNair AM, Cate Sheppard, Jeff Willcox, Kelvin Adams, Katriona Hill, Gini Skinner, David Spencer, Will Mitchell, Natalia Rode, Katherine Thornton, Lauren Maisey, Dustin Sprigg, Jacqui Lee, Daniel Wong, Aurora Killey, Darcy O'Connell, Emily Thrower) but does not say which prescribe.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ general practice, trans and gender diverse health, gender-affirming hormones, HIV, sexual health

name: Prahran Market Clinic
title: Clinic
address: Mezzanine Level, Pran Central, cnr Commercial Rd and Chapel St
description: "We proudly focus on sexual health and LGBTIQA+ health." Services listed include gay & lesbian health, transgender health, sexual health and HIV. Bulk billing is not guaranteed and is at the doctor's discretion. The team page names doctors (Beng Eu, Sven Strecker, Andrew Lang, Rebecca Overbury, Lisa Doyle, Varun Kommidi, Con Hatzis, Nikita Baidya, Elissa Ly, Jillian Gallagher, Fred Jayawardene, Tek Lim, Daffodil Joseph Anton) without bios saying who provides gender-affirming care.
specialties: LGBTIQA+ health, transgender health, sexual health, HIV
